visual.general_description: Two color clinical photographs (A and B) of skin findings: abdominal skin with streak-like bands and the lower leg and foot skin.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A (lower abdomen skin) and panel B (lower leg and dorsum of the foot with examiner fingers) are placed side by side with white printed letters A and B. Panel A: Close-up color photograph of brown skin of the abdomen with a printed purple-blue and pink fabric visible at the upper left corner and a red garment with a white drawstring at the lower part of the frame. Several roughly parallel streaks and bands run diagonally across the skin; some are darker brown, others lighter, with a dry, finely scaly or ridged surface texture within the bands. The remaining skin looks smooth and uniformly tan. The letter A is printed in white at the upper left. No ruler, scale, arrow, text label other than the panel letter, or identifying text is visible. Panel B: Close-up color photograph of the lower leg and dorsum of the foot of a person lying or seated with the limb held upright, with the toes at the lower right. Fingers of an examiner rest on the leg at the top of the frame. The brown skin of the leg has fine hair and a fine wrinkled, lined texture, with a bony prominence near the ankle. A metal ring is visible on one toe at the bottom. A dark brown surface, a white and teal sheet and red fabric form the background. The letter B is printed in white at the upper left of this panel. No ruler, scale or arrow is visible.
